name: Afghanistan
desc:
Welcome to Afghanistan!
Step into a world of danger and chaos. Engage in intense combat, eliminate your opponents, and push your team to victory in a relentless race to 250 kills.

👍 Like Goal: 10,500 Likes
Support the game by dropping a thumbs up — Every like helps us bring more updates, weapons, and maps to the game!

💬 Join the Group
Get your EXCLUSIVE [💀] chat tag here:
👉 https://www.roblox.com/communities/14791530

🚫 No Exploiting
Cheating is strictly prohibited — Cheaters will be PERMANENTLY banned with NO appeals!
Report cheaters in the communication server!

🧍 Movement Controls
Shift / L3 - Sprint
C / D-Pad - Crouch/Prone
X / D-Pad - Stand
Q - Left Lean
E - Right Lean
N - Patrol
B - Hold Up
M - Hold Down
Left Ctrl - Hold for Scroll Zoom

🔫 Weapon Controls
Left Click / R2 - Fire
Right Click / L2 - Aim
R / (X Controller) - Reload
F - Chamber Round
V - Switch Fire Mode
T - Switch Sights
J - Toggle Laser
H - Toggle Flashlight
Z - Toggle Bipod
